_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your real values. config.json holds a live access token - never commit or share it. config.json takes priority; anything left out is read from the environment instead: META_APP_ID, META_APP_SECRET, META_PAGE_ID, META_IG_USER_ID, META_ACCESS_TOKEN, META_API_VERSION, DRIVE_REMOTE, DRIVE_REVIEW_FOLDER_ID.
_drive_comment: Only needed for the Drive review flow (see SETUP-CLOUD.md). drive_remote is the rclone remote name; drive_review_folder_id is the ID from the review folder's Drive URL.
